rules.formula: as + adj/adv + as // Phủ định: not as/so + adj/adv + as
rules.examples: He is as tall as his brother. / This car is not as expensive as that one.

rules.formula: Ngắn: adj/adv-er + than // Dài: more + adj/adv + than // Bất quy tắc: good -> better, bad -> worse, far -> farther/further
rules.examples: She runs faster than me. / This book is more interesting than that one.

rules.formula: Ngắn: the + adj/adv-est // Dài: the most + adj/adv // Bất quy tắc: good -> the best, bad -> the worst
rules.examples: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

rules.formula: The + comparative + S + V, the + comparative + S + V
rules.examples: The harder you work, the more successful you become.

rules.rule: Từ bổ trợ nhấn mạnh trong so sánh hơn: MUCH, FAR, A LOT.
rules.examples: Living in the city is much more expensive than living in the countryside.
